diagnosis: Testbench reports `TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero` with tohost `FAIL 0xdead` per picorv32-fetch-misalign verdict. mem_la_addr drives low bits 2'b10 instead of expected 2'b00, so every fetch/lookahead is misaligned. Root cause is picorv32.v:382 where both branches of `mem_la_addr` concatenate `2'b10` instead of `2'b00`.
reason: Diagram shows mem_la_addr low bits stuck at 2'b10 feeding the fetch path, directly matching the trap and confirming the fix.
